tools.name: link_graph

tools.name: change_fingerprint

tools.name: readable_text

tools.name: batch_meta
tools.description: Page metadata for 1–10 public URLs in one payment. $0.15 USDC on Base (eip155:8453) via x402

tools.name: structured_data
tools.description: Extract schema.org JSON-LD, microdata and OpenGraph from a page. $0.01 per call.

tools.name: company_card

tools.name: watch_page
tools.description: Watch a page for 7 days and get a webhook when it changes. $0.10 per watch.
